mapper.insert: insert into sys_semester (name, start_date, end_date, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) values (#{name}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.update: update sys_semester set status = 0 where status = 1
mapper.select: select id, name, start_date, end_date, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user from sys_semester order by start_date desc, id desc
